name: HUSTLE
provisionalReason: Extracted from the redesign prototype (hustle-shell.html, landing + Stage 1). The production app does not use these tokens yet. Re-run /impeccable document in scan mode once they land in the real codebase.

narrative.northStarRationale: Township vernacular signwriting — hand-lettered spaza boards, enamel paint on warm metal, condensed capitals sized to be read across a road, one or two colours because paint costs money. Legible before pretty, because it is read outdoors on a cheap screen.

antiReference.what: The shipped build at hustle-simulation.netlify.app — cool #0B1724 navy dashboard, #162130 cards, single amber accent, Inter, emoji icon system, 10px micro-caps.
antiReference.why: Reads as a 2021 crypto/fintech admin panel and carries none of the world the writing establishes. Confirmed with the owner 2026-08-01 as unintentional. Replace, do not polish.

ink.note: Warm near-black. Never #000, never a cool navy.

surface-warm.note: Solid. Replaced a translucent rgba(226,87,30,.2) whose real contrast was unknowable.

bone-quiet.note: Nothing goes quieter than this token.

enamel-orange-lo.warning: Fails 4.5:1 against ink. Never place ink text on this.

shadows.philosophy: Printed, not glowing. One hard offset suggesting a physical painted board plus a neutral ambient drop. Chromatic glow is banned — a zero-offset coloured shadow on dark is the default generated-UI tell and the impeccable detector flags it as dark-glow.

rules: Stat bars use scaleX with transform-origin left, never width. Width animation thrashes layout and the detector flags it as layout-transition.
All durations collapse to 0.001ms under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

focus.note: The shipped bundle contains zero :focus and zero outline declarations across 421,113 chars. Measured live: outlineStyle 'none', boxShadow 'none'.

breakpoints.note: The shipped build has zero @media queries and one max-width:440px, wasting ~66% of a 1280px viewport.

texture.grain: fixed SVG feTurbulence baseFrequency .85 numOctaves 3, opacity .32, mix-blend-mode overlay, pointer-events none
texture.why: The base is never a flat fill. Pure flat vectors read sterile.

motif.name: enamel stripe
motif.why: A thick coloured border on one side of a card is the single most recognisable tell of AI-generated UI (detector rule: side-tab). The stripe carries two colours and a rhythm, which a border-left cannot. Caught in the first draft of the prototype — three instances — and replaced.

typographyFloors.label: 12px
typographyFloors.rule: Cut words, never shrink below the floor.
typographyFloors.evidence: Shipped build: 87 of ~144 fontSize declarations at <=13px, 25 at 10px. The failing text is the labelling layer — Demand, Competition, Cost — so the player compares numbers they cannot read in daylight.

tapTargets.evidence: Shipped −/+ are 143x40 as adjacent siblings. 9 of 10 targets on the Profile stage fail 44x44 on height.

gradientRule.rule: When text sits on a gradient, EVERY stop must clear the contrast threshold against that text colour — not just the light one.
gradientRule.evidence: Shipped primary CTA: #FFFFFF on linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F0F8, rgba(232,240,248,.733)) = 1.15:1 against both stops, on the only exit from Stage 1. The prototype's first fix attempt used enamel-orange → enamel-orange-lo; the dark stop measured 3.28:1 and also failed. Shipping pair is enamel-orange-hi → enamel-orange.
gradientRule.toolingCaveat: Both the impeccable detector and hand-rolled contrast harnesses resolve background via background-color only and ignore background-image, so they mis-report gradient buttons in BOTH directions — false-positive on dark-text-on-bright, false-negative risk on light-on-light. Always resolve gradient stops explicitly.

productRules: Persist to localStorage on every state change; push a history entry per stage. On a low-end Android that kills backgrounded tabs, a lost run is a lost lesson.
Gate heavy media behind an explicit tap. Poster is the default; video is opt-in. The audience pays for data by the megabyte.
The disabled state must name the unmet condition ('Spend 12 more points'), not restate the action in invisible ink.
Never pre-solve a stage. Stage 1 opens at 2/2/2/2 with 12 points to spend so the + control the tutorial describes is actually live.
Opportunity cards must differ before they are scanned — place name, signal tag, one-line teaser. Five identical placeholders make the first tap a coin flip inside a market-research stage.
bans: #FFF, #000, or any cool grey — every neutral here is warm
coloured glow shadow on dark (detector: dark-glow)

results.persistence: localStorage write verified on every mutation
